source.description:
Created with Inde game development in mind.
Ready to import to Unity, simply bake the axis during import and apply the textures and your good to go!
Scale, location and rotation has been correctly reset for game import.
I created the model with a balance of looks and simplicity in mind.
The model comes in two parts or as a whole and the origin is set between the two models to allow the upper portion to easily rotate.
Your free to use the model in games that you make and sell.
It is not OK to resell this model for profit on its own or part of a set.
Consider this a creative commons asset.
